title: Restore purchase crashes when entitlement-service returns entitlements=null

backendSourceFix.summary: entitlement-service normalizes nil entitlements to an empty slice before serializing /v1/entitlements/me. The live localhost runtime was later replaced and now returns entitlements as an empty array.

androidFix.summary: EntitlementSummaryDto tolerates entitlements=null and maps it to emptyList() in domain conversion, eliminating the JsonDecodingException on device restore.

runtimeVerification.reason: The entitlement-service live instance was replaced, the image digest changed, and the live probe now returns entitlements=[].
